meta.name: lsp-setup
meta.description: Configures a language server so editor/agent tooling (diagnostics, go-to-definition, references, rename) works. Use when a project needs an LSP installed or wired, or a 'no LSP server configured' error appears.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 配置语言服务器，让编辑器自动提供代码检查与跳转功能。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写代码时遇到未配置语言服务器的提示，导致编辑器没有代码检查与跳转。
copy.tagline_en: Configure a language server to enable code diagnostics and navigation in your editor.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your editor keeps saying no language server is configured when you code.

howto.what: Claude 会先按文件扩展名识别项目语言，读取对应参考文档，安装并配置该语言的语言服务器，再跑一次真实诊断往返验证。配好之后，诊断、跳转定义、查找引用、重命名这些 lsp 工具才真正可用。
howto.when: 当项目需要安装或接入语言服务器，或出现「no LSP server configured」这类错误时接管。它先看文件扩展名确定语言，再进入安装、配置、验证流程。

say.text: 帮我检测这个项目需要哪些语言服务器，并装好。
say.note: 先跑 detect-lsp 扫描，再按语言安装。

say.text: 给这个项目配一下 TypeScript 的语言服务器。
say.note: 读对应的语言参考并写配置文件。

say.text: 验证一下 src/index.ts 的诊断能不能跑通。
say.note: 跑真实 LSP 往返，返回 OK 或 FAIL。

howto.what_en: Claude identifies the project's languages from file extensions, installs and wires the matching language server, then runs a real diagnostics roundtrip to verify. Only after that do the lsp tools (diagnostics, go-to-definition, references, rename) work.
howto.when_en: Use when a project needs an LSP installed or wired, or when a "no LSP server configured" error appears. It first identifies the language from the file extension, then installs, configures and verifies.

say_en.text: Detect which language servers this project needs and install them.
say_en.note: Runs detect-lsp, then installs per language.

say_en.text: Set up the TypeScript language server for this project.
say_en.note: Reads the language reference and writes config.

say_en.text: Verify that diagnostics work for src/index.ts.
say_en.note: Runs a real LSP roundtrip; reports OK or FAIL.
